verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly the same, and both have the same main faults. The logo is jammed against the canvas edge and touches the headline. The SAVE badge floats over the body copy and crowds it. The coffee bag is a tiny sliver cut off at the right edge, so the product is lost. A's CTA button is undersized and weak. B's larger CTA gives slightly better hierarchy, but its oversized badge competes with the headline and nearly touches the copy below it.
